title: Limits of the level-independent fall: level superpositions, records, the operator under the factor

key_results.statement: Exact in the gradients and in $\kappa$, for every $\alpha$, smooth $g$, $\chi$, $\lambda$ and chain: $p_x=\sum_k|\alpha_k|^2p^{(k)}_x$ and $\bar x_{\rm lab}=\sum_k|\alpha_k|^2\bar x_k$; it rests on the conservation of the level and the orthonormality of the $|f_k\rangle$.

Drift acceleration of $\Phi_\sigma[\alpha,g]$ (first order, long chain, $\Lambda\to\infty$ at fixed $g$, then sharp label; leading order in $\kappa$): $\sum_k|\alpha_k|^2a_{k,\sigma}(p_0)$, with an exact window bound; it is the same for all $\alpha$ iff $a_{k,\sigma}(p_0)$ is level-independent (at rest: line 1 or 2 of (4.19), no new condition).

Starts at rest, fixed smooth $g$, first order: $D=\tfrac14\lambda^4\mathrm{Var}_\alpha(\langle a_{\cdot,\sigma}\rangle_g)+E$ with $|E|\le r\lambda^3\sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_\alpha}+r^2\lambda^2$; the coefficient of $\lambda^4$ tends to $\tfrac14\mathrm{Var}_\alpha(a_{\cdot,\sigma}(0))$ in the sharp-label limit.

Class $\mathcal C$, $|\alpha_k|^2=1/N$, sharp-label limit of the $\lambda^4$ part of $D$: zero for the variants (a), (c); $\tfrac14\lambda^4\tau^4g^2m^2\mathcal V_N$ for (b1), (b2); $\tfrac14\lambda^4\tau^4g^2c_{\rm f}^2\mathcal V_N$ for (f).

Zero gradients: sharp-label velocity of the level component $k$ is $\sigma\omega_k'(p_0)$; for $\sin2p_0\neq0$ two levels have equal sharp-label velocities iff $\tau_k^4/(M_k^2+\tau_k^2\sin^2p_0)=\tau_{k'}^4/(M_{k'}^2+\tau_{k'}^2\sin^2p_0)$; never in the class $\mathcal C$ for distinct levels, while starts of finite width can have equal velocities in every member of $\mathcal C_{\rm lev}$.
Bound, every start concentrated at $p_0$: $|v_k-\sigma\omega_k'(p_0)|\le\tfrac12\sup|\omega_k'''|\delta p^2$, so $v_k\neq v_{k'}$ whenever $\delta p<\delta p_*$.
Exact in the gradients: $\mathrm d\bar p_k/\mathrm d\lambda=-\int\frac{\mathrm dp}{2\pi}c^\dagger B_kc+(c^\dagger B_kc)(p_0+\pi)$, with the weight crossing the cut of the arc.

First order, every smooth $g$: $\mathrm d\bar p_k/\mathrm d\lambda=\langle\pi_{k,\sigma}\rangle_g-|g(p_0+\pi)|^2\pi_{k,\sigma}(p_0+\pi)$ with $\pi_{k,\sigma}(p)=\mathcal F_k-\sigma(G_kM_k+g_{\zeta,k}\tau_k^2\sin^2p)/\omega_k(p)$; for starts at rest with $\delta p\to0$ and $|g(\pi)|^2\to0$ the limit is $\mathcal F_k-\sigma G_k$.

Bound, every start at rest: the first-order rate of the arc mean differs from $(1-|g(\pi)|^2)(\mathcal F_k-\sigma G_k)$ by at most $\tfrac12\sup|\pi_{k,\sigma}''|\delta p^2$; for sequences with $c_{\rm cut}\neq1$ the limiting rate is level-independent iff $\mathcal F_k-\sigma G_k$ is, and together with a level-independent drift acceleration $a\neq0$ iff also $\tau_k^2/M_k$ is (impossible in $\mathcal C$).

Clock-label statistics of $\Phi_\sigma[\alpha,g]$: $P(a;\lambda)=\frac1N\sum_{k,k'}\alpha_{k'}^*\alpha_k\Gamma_{kk'}(\lambda)e^{2\pi i(k-k')a/N}$; exact with the medium in the level components, and with the $\Gamma_{kk'}$ of the effective body contract at leading order in $\kappa$.

Zero gradients, every smooth $g$: $\Gamma^{(0)}_{kk'}=e^{-i(V_k-V_{k'})\lambda}\langle\cos\tfrac{\theta_k-\theta_{k'}}2e^{-i\sigma(\omega_k-\omega_{k'})\lambda}\rangle_g$; for even $g$, $\Gamma_{kk'}$ is exactly even in the gradients.

Exact, every smooth $g$, $p_0$, $\lambda$: $\Gamma_{kk'}[g;\text{gradients}]=\Gamma_{kk'}[g^-;-\text{gradients}]$ with $g^-(p)=g(-p)$; for starts of definite parity $|\Gamma_{kk'}|$ is even in the gradients.

Exact Taylor expansion in the gradients, every smooth $g$, $p_0$ and $\lambda$ with $\Gamma^{(0)}_{kk'}\neq0$: $|\Gamma_{kk'}|/|\Gamma^{(0)}_{kk'}|=1+\mathrm{Re}\,\epsilon_1+Q_2+O(\text{grad}^3)$, $Q_2=-\tfrac12\mathcal V+\tfrac12(\mathrm{Im}\,\epsilon_1)^2+\mathrm{Re}\,\epsilon_2$, with the bound $|\epsilon_1|\le\eta_0\mathcal V^{1/2}$.

Order of the first deviation of $|\Gamma_{kk'}|$, complete case distinction: none for equal level blocks; degree one (not linear) at a zero of $\Gamma^{(0)}_{kk'}$; first order iff $\mathrm{Re}\,\epsilon_1\neq0$; second order iff $\mathrm{Re}\,\epsilon_1=0\neq Q_2$; otherwise third order or higher; $\mathrm{Re}\,\epsilon_1=0$ for starts of definite parity and for pairs with equal $(\tau,M)$.

Exact, every smooth complex $g$, $p_0$, $\lambda\ge0$: the complete first-order term $\Gamma^{(1)}_{kk'}$ of the coherence (branch part plus inter-branch part), and $(|\Gamma_{kk'}|/|\Gamma^{(0)}_{kk'}|)_1=\mathrm{Re}(\Gamma^{(1)}_{kk'}/\Gamma^{(0)}_{kk'})$ where $\Gamma^{(0)}_{kk'}\neq0$.

Exact first-order inter-branch amplitude $a_{k,\perp}$ for every smooth $g$, with the bound $\|a_{k,\perp}\|\le A_{k,\perp}(\lambda)$, linear in $\lambda$ with a coefficient proportional to $\langle\sin^4p\rangle_g^{1/2}$.

Exact inter-branch part $\Gamma^{(1),\perp}_{kk'}$ of the first-order coherence, with the bound $|\Gamma^{(1),\perp}_{kk'}|\le\tfrac12(\tau_k/M_k+\tau_{k'}/M_{k'})\langle\sin^2p\rangle_g^{1/2}(A_{k,\perp}+A_{k',\perp})$.

Bound, every start at rest: $1-|\Gamma^{(0)}_{kk'}(\lambda)|\le\epsilon_0(\lambda)=[\tfrac12\lambda\sup|\omega_k''-\omega_{k'}''|+\tfrac18(\tau_k/M_k+\tau_{k'}/M_{k'})^2]\delta p^2$; $\Gamma^{(0)}_{kk'}\neq0$ where $\epsilon_0<1$.
Bound, every start at rest: $\delta x_g^2\delta p^2\ge C_g^2+\tfrac14(1-|g(\pi)|^2)^2$, hence $2\delta pX_g\ge|1-|g(\pi)|^2|$ (the uncertainty inequality on the arc, with the boundary term).

Narrow starts at rest of any shape (class (N), range $\epsilon_0\ll1$; order estimate with exact coefficients of the local form): $Q_2\simeq-\tfrac12\mathrm{Var}_g(K_{kk'})=-[\tfrac12\lambda^2(\pi_k-\pi_{k'})^2\delta x_g^2+\tfrac12\sigma\lambda^3(\pi_k-\pi_{k'})\varpi_{kk'}C_g+\tfrac18\lambda^4\varpi_{kk'}^2\delta p^2]$, with the exact lower bound $\mathrm{Var}_g(K_{kk'})\ge(1-|g(\pi)|^2)^2\max\{\lambda^2(\pi_k-\pi_{k'})^2/(4\delta p^2),\lambda^4\varpi_{kk'}^2/(16\delta x_g^2)\}$; it is different from zero iff $(\pi_k-\pi_{k'},\varpi_{kk'})\neq(0,0)$.

Real Gaussian starts at rest (special case of (7.38); order estimate): $1-|\Gamma_{kk'}|/|\Gamma^{(0)}_{kk'}|\simeq\tfrac12\delta x^2(\pi_k-\pi_{k'})^2\lambda^2+\frac{\lambda^4}{32\delta x^2}\varpi_{kk'}^2$ with $\pi_k=\mathcal F_k-\sigma G_k$.

At first order jointly in $G_k$, $\mathcal F_k$, $g_{\zeta,k}$ and $\kappa(\xi-\langle X\rangle)$, for every $\chi$: the first-order velocity of a branch start does not change when $X$ is not sharp; (4.7), (4.16), (4.19) are unchanged.

Zero gradients, exact pointwise in $p$: the $\varepsilon^2$ coefficient of the velocity is $v_2=\sigma[\tfrac12\lambda^2\omega'''-\tfrac{\theta'\theta''}{4\omega}(1-\cos2\omega\lambda)-\tfrac{\lambda}{2\omega}\theta'(\omega\theta')'\sin2\omega\lambda-\tfrac12\lambda^2\theta'^2\omega'\cos2\omega\lambda]$.

Zero gradients, fixed smooth $g$, Taylor expansion in $\kappa$: $v=\sigma\langle\omega_k'\rangle_g+\kappa^2\sigma_X^2[\tfrac12\lambda^2\sigma\langle\omega_k'''\rangle_g+R_2]+\kappa^3\mu_3[-\tfrac16\lambda^3\sigma\langle\omega_k''''\rangle_g+R_3]+O(\kappa^4)$; exact bound on $R_2$, linear in $\lambda$; $R_3=O(t_k\nu_k\lambda^3\mathcal D_k^{-1/2})$ for $\mathcal D_k\gg1$ (order estimate).

Exact, every smooth $g$ and $\lambda$: the change of the acceleration at order $\kappa^2$ is $\kappa^2\sigma_X^2\langle\partial_\lambda v_2\rangle_g$ with $\partial_\lambda v_2=\sigma[\lambda\omega'''+\lambda^2\omega\omega'\theta'^2\sin2\omega\lambda-\lambda\theta'(2\omega'\theta'+\omega\theta'')\cos2\omega\lambda-\tfrac{\theta'}{2\omega}(2\omega\theta''+\omega'\theta')\sin2\omega\lambda]$.

The sharp-label limit and the growth of $\lambda$ do not commute: case A (fixed smooth $g$, long window or $\mathcal D_k\to\infty$, then sharp label in the coefficient) gives (7.15), (7.16); case B ($\delta p\to0$ at fixed $\lambda$ or window, $\mathcal D_k\to0$) gives (7.42), (7.43); in between (7.41) holds exactly.

Case A, order $\kappa^2$: $\delta a^{(2)}_{k,\sigma}=-\kappa^2\sigma_X^2\lambda v(4+3\omega_k''(p_0)/\omega_k(p_0))$ for every $p_0$, equal to $-\kappa^2\sigma_X^2\lambda(4+3\tau_k^2/M_k^2)v$ near rest ($|p_0|\ll p_c$); zero at rest, first order in $v$, the same in both branches, level-independent iff $\tau_k/M_k$ is (not in $\mathcal C$).

Case A, order $\kappa^3$, at rest: $\delta a^{(3)}_{k,\sigma}=\tfrac\sigma2\kappa^3\mu_3\lambda^2\tfrac{\tau_k^2}{M_k}(4+\tfrac{3\tau_k^2}{M_k^2})$; zeroth order in $v$, odd in the branch, only for a skewed $X$, level-independent iff $\nu_k(4+3t_k)$ is (not in $\mathcal C$).

Window average at fixed smooth $g$: $|\overline{a_2}-2s_2\bar\lambda|\le(2c_1[g]\bar\lambda+2c_0)/\Lambda$ (bound) and $\overline{a_3}=3s_3(\bar\lambda^2+\Lambda^2/12)+(R_3(\lambda_1+\Lambda)-R_3(\lambda_1))/\Lambda$; a long window is sufficient for the secular term to dominate.

Case B, order $\kappa^2$, near rest: $\delta a^{(2)}_{k,\sigma}=\kappa^2\sigma_X^2v[-(4+3t_k)\lambda+\lambda\cos2\omega\lambda+\nu_k\lambda^2\sin2\omega\lambda+\tfrac{2+3t_k}{2M_k}\sin2\omega\lambda]$; zero at rest, first order in $v$, level-independent iff $(\tau_k,M_k)$ are; with an exact bound for the window average at a sharp label.

Case B, order $\kappa^3$, at rest, exact: $\partial_\lambda v_3(0,\lambda)=\sigma\{\tfrac{\nu_k}2\lambda^2[(4+3t_k)-\cos2M_k\lambda]-\tfrac{\tau_k^2t_k}3\lambda^3\sin2M_k\lambda-\tfrac{t_k(2+t_k)}4\lambda\sin2M_k\lambda-\tfrac{t_k(1+2t_k)}{4M_k}(1-\cos2M_k\lambda)\}$, with the exact $v_3(0,\lambda)$.

Bound for one level: $\|\mathrm d\bar x/\mathrm d\lambda\|\le c_k=\tau_kd_0$ for every state in the level $k$; $c_k\le d_0\max_j\tau_j\le v^{\rm full}_{\max}$, the row-sum bound of the complete body contract; they coincide iff the $\tau_j$ are equal.

Case A, near rest, in the background of (17.15) of 03-ilang-space/17-motion: $\delta\,\mathrm d^2\bar x/\mathrm d\lambda^2=[-\lambda(4d_0^2+3c_k^2/M_k^2)u+\tfrac{\sigma\gamma_X}2\lambda^2\tfrac{c_k^2}{M_k}(4d_0^2+3c_k^2/M_k^2)](1+O(p_0^2/p_c^2))\hat e$.

The case-A record terms are smaller than the drift acceleration (4.7) at rest where $\varrho_2<1$ and $\varrho_3<1$, that is $\lambda<\lambda_2\propto|\sigma\mathcal F_k-G_k|/(\kappa^2|v|)$ and $\lambda<\lambda_3\propto(|\sigma\mathcal F_k-G_k|/\kappa^3)^{1/2}$.

Rests of the window averages relative to the drift acceleration: $\varrho_{2,\rm rest}=\kappa^2\sigma_X^2\frac{2c_1[g]\bar\lambda+2c_0}{\Lambda}\frac{M_k}{\tau_k^2|\sigma\mathcal F_k-G_k|}$ (bound) and $\varrho_{3,\rm rest}=O(\kappa^3|\mu_3|t_k\bar\lambda^3/(\Lambda\mathcal D_k^{1/2}|\sigma\mathcal F_k-G_k|))$ (order estimate).

Weak records, at the retained orders: if $\varrho_2+\varrho_{2,\rm rest}+\tfrac43\varrho_3+\varrho_{3,\rm rest}\le\delta_{\rm acc}$ for every level involved, the record terms change the window-averaged acceleration by at most $\delta_{\rm acc}$ times the drift acceleration and levels with equal drift acceleration fall alike to $2\delta_{\rm acc}$; sufficient, not uniform in $\lambda$, violated for gradients $\to0$ at fixed $\kappa$.
On-site block $(1+gx)[M_k\sigma_3+u_k]-\mathcal F_Ux$: $a_{k,\pm}(0)=-g\tau_k^2\pm\tfrac{\tau_k^2}{M_k}(\mathcal F_U-gu_k)$.

Fall from rest the same for all levels: upper branch iff $\tau_k^2[(\mathcal F_U-gu_k)/M_k-g]$ is level-independent, lower branch iff $\tau_k^2[-(\mathcal F_U-gu_k)/M_k-g]$ is, both with one value $a$ iff $gu_k=\mathcal F_U$ and $g\tau_k^2=-a$ for all $k$.

Well defined (M6): $g$, $M_k$, $u_k-u_{k'}$, $\mathcal F_U-gu_k$; not well defined: $u_k$, '$u_k=0$ for all $k$', '$u_k\propto M_k$' (the effective contract is defined modulo $c\,\mathbb 1$, which shifts $(u_k,\mathcal F_U)$ to $(u_k+c,\mathcal F_U+gc)$).

Table of the orders in the gradients, $v$, $M_k/\tau_k$, $\kappa$ and $\lambda$ at which the lattice, the drift velocity, a superposition of levels, the records, the operator under the factor and a plain gradient change the level-independent fall and the relation (4.24).

open_issues: The third order in the gradients of the modulus of the coherence (case (O3) of (7.36)) is outside the scope and not derived.
(7.32) and the remainder of (7.25) are order estimates with their calculations; no constants and no bounds are derived for them, apart from (7.29), (7.30), (7.31), (7.37).
R_3 in (7.14) is an order estimate without a constant; for p_0 ≠ 0 in case B only the term of v_3 with the highest power of λ is given.
Terms that mix κ with the gradients, the order κ^4 and the second order in the gradients of the acceleration are outside the scope; (7.46) is a statement at the retained orders.
(7.3): the constant r of the bound on E depends on g; nothing is stated on D at fixed λ in the sharp-label limit.
The effect of an operator under the factor on the relation (4.24) outside the class C needs the clock rate of that body, which is not among the quoted inputs.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions of (7.15), (7.16), (7.43), (7.38), (7.40), (7.18), (7.34) with costs in units of 1/λ and dimensionless labels

One level only, a sharp X, a plain gradient only, and a real Gaussian start: (7.1), (7.2), (7.8), (7.11), (7.14)-(7.17), (7.41)-(7.43), (7.29) reduce correctly; (7.38) gives (7.10), and the first-order term from Θ_1 reproduces (7.25)

Short-λ expansions: (7.13) against the double commutator; (7.42) at small λ is the derivative of (7.13) near rest; in (7.43) the coefficients of λ and λ^3 of v_3(0,λ) and of λ^2 of its derivative vanish
